from pathlib import Path

def rec(id, act, s=b'a'):
    payload=id.to_bytes(4,'little')+act+s
    return bytes([len(payload)])+payload
out=Path('/tmp/topic_enum'); out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
actions=[b'S',b'U',b'F',b'A',b'O',b'P',b'D']
ids=[0,1,2]
topics=[b'',b'a',b'b']
# directed sequences likely
seqs=[]
# all length 4-6 over compact records with constrained ids/topics for first N? generate 3^? too much
for free_id in [1,2,0]:
  for drain_id in [1,2,0]:
    for t1 in topics:
      for t2 in topics:
        for pubt in topics:
          seqs.append([(1,b'S',t1),(2,b'S',t2),(0,b'P',pubt),(free_id,b'F',b''),(drain_id,b'O',b'')])
          seqs.append([(1,b'S',t1),(2,b'S',t2),(0,b'P',pubt),(free_id,b'F',b''),(drain_id,b'D',b'')])
          seqs.append([(1,b'S',t1),(2,b'S',t2),(0,b'P',pubt),(free_id,b'U',t1),(drain_id,b'O',b'')])
          seqs.append([(1,b'S',t1),(2,b'S',t2),(0,b'P',pubt),(free_id,b'A',b''),(drain_id,b'O',b'')])
# add many publishes to hit 32 drain
for n in [31,32,33,34,65,256]:
  seqs.append([(1,b'S',b'a')]+[(0,b'P',b'a')]*n)
  seqs.append([(1,b'S',b'a')]+[(0,b'P',b'a')]*n+[(1,b'F',b''),(0,b'D',b'')])
for i,seq in enumerate(seqs):
    b=b''.join(rec(*r) for r in seq)
    (out/f'id_{i}').write_bytes(b)
print(len(seqs), out)

# These are fetched from libEpollFuzzer

oss-fuzz:
# Copy dictionaries
        cp *.dict $(OUT)
# libEpollFuzzer cases
        # Compile uSockets without -flto

        $(CC) $(CFLAGS) -DLIBUS_NO_SSL -std=c11 -I../uSockets/src -O3 -c ../uSockets/src/*.c ../uSockets/src/eventing/*.c ../uSockets/src/crypto/*.c

        $(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(WRAPPED_SYSCALLS) -std=c++17 -O3 -DUWS_MOCK_ZLIB -I../src -I../uSockets/src EpollEchoServerPubSub.cpp -o $(OUT)/EpollEchoServerPubSub $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE) *.o
# "Unit tests"
        $(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -std=c++17 -O3 Extensions.cpp -o $(OUT)/Extensions $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)
        $(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -std=c++17 -O3 QueryParser.cpp -o $(OUT)/QueryParser $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)
        $(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -std=c++17 -O3 MultipartParser.cpp -o $(OUT)/MultipartParser $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)
        $(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -std=c++17 -O3 -I../uSockets/src WebSocket.cpp -o $(OUT)/WebSocket $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)
        $(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -std=c++17 -O3 Http.cpp -o $(OUT)/Http $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)

        $(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -std=c++17 -O3 TopicTree.cpp -o $(OUT)/TopicTree $(LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE)
